caveat: The three builds' 95% intervals overlap almost entirely, so this measurement cannot tell them apart. Head-to-head matches between two builds are far more sensitive (identical engines, one flag different) and did show gains; those gains have not been confirmed against an outside opponent. Treat the current figure as roughly 1900, not as a precise rating.

agreement.note: How often the engine picks Stockfish's move. It stops improving after depth 4, so extra search is no longer buying better moves. With a material-only evaluation it falls after depth 4 instead: a deeper search optimises harder for whatever the evaluation says is good, so a weak evaluation gets worse with depth. The evaluation is the ceiling.
